$comment: LifeTwin twin sprites (v2 set, design/sprites/v2). Paths are Flutter asset keys; 2.0x/ and 3.0x/ variants are picked automatically. pose/ wears the Cal hat, pose_nohat/ is the same pose without it: each hat sprite is its no-hat sprite with one canonical hat composited on, and the pair share one canvas, so size1x and anchor are identical. anchor = fractions of the image: x/y = feet centre / feet bottom (feet_anchor from manifest_v2.json, re-based to the padded app canvas); the painted content fills 93% of the height (3.5% padding top and bottom). Long side 180/360/540 px for 1x/2.0x/3.0x, never upscaled past native. Vector copies (not bundled): assets/twin/svg/. Keep names in sync with docs/design/painted-card-direction.md section 6.
